positive.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Turn the PRD into an ordered task list we can execute
Plan the work into implementable chunks before we start coding

negative.prompt: Encode the output so it is safe against XSS

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: Ordered tasks in /specs/notifications/tasks/plan.md, each small and verifiable, with acceptance criteria, dependencies, and an explicit stacked-PR Delivery Plan
expectations: Tasks are vertical slices rather than horizontal layers
The plan maps every task to a phase, stack, exact trunk, branch name, start condition, and PR layer
The repository default branch is detected and used as the common planning trunk unless another trunk is explicitly approved
Sequential dependencies stay in stack order while parallel-safe tasks are assigned to separate stacks
A stack with cross-stack dependencies starts only after those checkpoints merge into its single declared trunk
Exactly one final layer is designated to close the future build issue
No implementation code is written during planning
